records.title: Reduced melanocortin tone mediates increased feeding during pregnancy in mice
records.discoveryReason: ARC Xenium, biological animal replication sufficient in3retained groups; targeted panel coverage must be checked for each gene. Outside strict RNAseq-only assay scope.
records.biologicalReplication: Virgin-fed5,virgin-fasted5,pregnant-fed5; pregnant-restricted5 damaged/excluded
records.intakeReason: Targeted Xenium assay: needs panel-aware analysis and an animal/section/slide map before the RNA-seq explorer can represent it.

records.title: Transcriptomic Signatures Reveal Overlapping Shared and DistinctYet State-Specific Preoptic Neuronal Ensembles Activated by Anesthesia and Sleep
records.discoveryReason: POA explicitly dissected in extraction protocol. Mouse-specific excitatory/inhibitory/non-neuronal matrices allow pseudobulk; one MTX verified nonnegative integer. GSE243489 is reference annotation, not reused experimental mice.
records.biologicalReplication: 5 females and5 males per isoflurane/O2 treatment;20 independent mice
records.intakeReason: Twenty independently sequenced mice, five of each sex per oxygen/isoflurane arm. Submitted excitatory, inhibitory and non-neuronal nuclei are summed within each mouse. Treatment models adjust for sex. GSE243489 supplies the reference taxonomy and contributes no samples.

records.title: Atlas of gene expression in the Murciano-Granadina goat
records.discoveryReason: Six animal IDs and six HYT columns match. Fractional tximport gene estimates need accompanying offsets/lengths; public counts and all198 project FASTQs.
records.biologicalReplication: Dry goats54,64,73 vs lactating goats2,3,6; n3 vs3 hypothalamus
records.intakeReason: Goat counts, lengths and CPM were downloaded. The current intake adapter supports mouse and rat annotation; goat identifiers and pathway ortholog coverage require a validated mapping.

records.title: Transcriptomics of the hypothalamus, pituitary gland, liver and adipose tissue of Tan sheep under dietary succinic acid treatment
records.discoveryReason: 24 sheep randomized12/arm; sequenced subset4/arm. No pooling described. Processed matrix is TPM; all32 RNA runs including8 hypothalamus have accessible FASTQ.
records.biologicalReplication: 4 control vs4 succinic-acid hypothalamus samples; samples X_CON_1..4 and X_SA_1..4
records.intakeReason: Sheep expression matrix was downloaded. Sheep gene annotation and pathway ortholog mapping are not implemented in this intake adapter.

records.title: Effect of Smchd1 deletion via Nestin-Cre in mouse brain tissue II
records.discoveryReason: TotalRNA companion is an alternate assay of the same animals, not a new independent study. Supplied log2 table has negative values. All6 SRA archive URLs HEAD200.
records.biologicalReplication: Same3 wildtype and3 deleted mice as329973;12 allele columns are paired within6 animals
records.intakeReason: Companion allelic-expression series. Requires explicit allele, animal and tissue bindings and a suitable normalized-expression or raw-read workflow.

records.title: Effect of Smchd1 deletion via Nestin-Cre in mouse brain tissue I
records.discoveryReason: Whole hypothalamus confirmed. mRNA and totalRNA companion329974 share the same6 core mice. Processed log2RPM is not counts; all46 source-provided SRA archive URLs HEAD200.
records.biologicalReplication: Female wildtype mice7,54,72 vs deleted6,13,57; n3 vs3. Additional genotype controls5 and7 specimens.
records.intakeReason: Allelic-expression design requires explicit parental-allele and animal bindings before standard contrasts can be fitted.

records.title: Sleep Homeostasis Ensembles in the Hypothalamic PVN Reprogram Systemic Fuel Utilization via Adipose Lipolysis
records.discoveryReason: PVN activity-ensemble BacTRAP; compare IP vsIP across independent pools. 43,349-gene matrix,18paired assay columns,zero fractional/missing/negative entries.
records.biologicalReplication: Control5 independent pools vs rebound4 independent pools;7 animals/pool; IP and Input paired
records.intakeReason: Five control and four rebound pools, each containing seven mice. Only immunoprecipitated RNA is compared. Input assays are paired to these pools and excluded from this track.

records.title: Agouti integrates environmental cues to regulate paternal behaviour
records.discoveryReason: Sample title/source/anatomical characteristic has a target-region term; biological groups, pooling and anatomical ambiguity require adjudication.
records.biologicalReplication: Not inferred from GSM count. Exact sample/animal/pool grouping requires adjudication for candidate records.
records.intakeReason: One animal per submitted Seurat object, with no pooling. RNA count layers are aggregated by mouse after excluding submitted doublet calls. Three naive control, three alloparental, three infanticidal males, four sires and four dams. Dam-versus-sire differences combine sex and parental-role differences; they are not an isolated hormone effect.

records.title: Transcriptomic Profiling of the Hypothalamic PVN in a Rat Model of Hypertension
records.discoveryReason: Paper verifies bilateral 1 mm PVN punches from 60 um coronal sections. All 19 GEO samples are PVN.
records.biologicalReplication: Not inferred from GSM count. Exact sample/animal/pool grouping requires adjudication for candidate records.
records.intakeReason: Nine Wistar and ten spontaneously hypertensive rats. Sex is a model covariate; the deposited cohort lacks Wistar male 1.

records.title: CNS-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor TN-783 achieves durable weight loss and reverses hypothalamic inflammation in diet-induced obesity
records.discoveryReason: Microdissected hypothalamus. Fractional Salmon gene estimates, explicitly without length correction; compatible import required. All18 SRA archives HEAD200.
records.biologicalReplication: 6 lean,6 diet-induced-obese vehicle,6 DIO TN-783 males
records.intakeReason: Six mice each in lean untreated, diet-induced obese vehicle and DIO TN-783 groups. Limma uses the author-supplied log2 CPM sheet without a second logarithm or count model. Duplicate gene-symbol rows are averaged on the supplied log scale. Salmon estimates are retained in the workbook but are not treated as integer raw counts.

records.title: Transcriptome data derived from muscle and brain in CT-26-induced mouse cancer cachexia models
records.discoveryReason: Six GSM titles explicitly identify hypothalamus; the other six are gastrocnemius from the same mice.
records.biologicalReplication: Not inferred from GSM count. Exact sample/animal/pool grouping requires adjudication for candidate records.
records.intakeReason: Three CT-26 cachexia and three healthy mice. Only hypothalamus samples are included. Deposited RSEM gene TPM, effective lengths and expected counts are imported with lengthScaledTPM correction; fractional estimates are retained. Each corrected library preserves its original expected-count total.

records.title: A protective role of SRC-1 against aging associated cognitive decline
records.discoveryReason: GEO tissue Brain/Hypothalamus is confirmed by paper hypothalamic dissection diagram and RNA-seq methods.
records.biologicalReplication: Not inferred from GSM count. Exact sample/animal/pool grouping requires adjudication for candidate records.
records.intakeReason: Three wild-type and three SRC-1 knockout hypothalamus samples. GEO sample descriptions explicitly map YX3878-YX3883 to the featureCounts columns.

records.title: Obesity disrupts CtBP2-mediated maintenance of the transcriptional equilibrium in hypothalamic feeding circuitry [AgRP KO]
records.discoveryReason: Raw access recovered beyond ENA gaps: all8 public SRA archives HEAD200. BigWig-only processed files require RNA quantification. Fed arm labels consistent.
records.biologicalReplication: 4 AgRP-neuron CtBP2 knockout vs4 floxed-control whole-hypothalamus animals
records.intakeReason: Public processed inputs are coverage tracks rather than a gene-by-sample count matrix; raw reads must be quantified first.

records.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals the effects of high-fat diet on hypothalamic(ARC) and hindbrain(DVC) glucose sensing [Experimentally induced hyperglycemia in diet-induced obese mice]
records.discoveryReason: ARC/VMHsnRNA;30GEO entries are15RNA+15HTO assays. Independent animal labels and postQC cells verified. Exclude DVC using per-cell anatomy; one XLSX DVC16 row is miscoded.
records.biologicalReplication: 20 hashed mice: control-diet saline4,glucose5;HFD saline5,glucose6
records.intakeReason: ARC/VMH cells aggregated by hashed mouse after submitted discard/doublet filtering. DVC cells are excluded using cell anatomy and Arc animal IDs. Major classes require 20 nuclei per mouse; Ghrh requires 10. Each displayed population retains at least three mice in all four arms. The pilot GSE262408 is a separate cohort and is not included.

records.title: Glycogen Metabolism Drives Sensory Activation of Pomc Neurons
records.discoveryReason: ARC-enriched microdissections with anti-HA immunoprecipitation from POMC-RiboTag mice.
records.biologicalReplication: Not inferred from GSM count. Exact sample/animal/pool grouping requires adjudication for candidate records.
records.intakeReason: Six POMC-RiboTag mice per condition after a 16-hour fast. Only the 5,764 genes in the deposited CPM matrix are available; results and pathway coverage are restricted to that gene universe. The matrix is summed on the linear scale for duplicate symbols and transformed as log2(CPM+1) for limma. Counts are not reconstructed from CPM. Cage identifiers are not deposited.

records.title: Cagrilintide and retatrutide combination therapy enhances weight loss and metabolic outcomes in obese rats

records.intakeReason: Unscaled Salmon gene counts were downloaded, but effective lengths or quant.sf files are absent from the reviewed processed deposit. This non-3-prime assay needs length-aware import.

records.title: Giant island mice exhibit widespread gene regulatory evolution in key metabolic organs
records.discoveryReason: PRJNA587779 is the paper’s WGS accession and must not be used as RNA-seq alias. Primary paper treats each mouse as independent.
records.biologicalReplication: 20 whole-hypothalamus samples, Gough10/WSB10;5male+5female per strain at28days. Multiple litters; model strain/sex and account for litter where recoverable.
records.intakeReason: Ten four-week-old Gough Island and ten WSB hypothalamus samples, each strain with five females and five males. RSEM expected counts, TPM and effective lengths supply a lengthScaledTPM import that preserves library totals. The model adjusts for sex. Litter identity is unavailable in the deposited sample metadata, so litter effects cannot be separated.
